Sandbox_PassOut_EnableMod_tooltip: Master switch for the whole mod. Turn this off to disable passing out entirely without removing the mod from the save.
Sandbox_PassOutHours_tooltip:
How many in-game hours you must stay at the tiredness level set below before you start passing out.
Set to 0 to pass out almost immediately once that level is reached.
Sandbox_PassOutRandomness_tooltip:
Randomly shifts Pass Out Hours up or down so the timing is less predictable.
0.0 = no randomness.
0.5 = between 0.5x and 1.5x Pass Out Hours.
1.0 = between 0x and 2x Pass Out Hours.
Sandbox_PassOut_TiredLevel_tooltip:
How tired you must be for the pass-out countdown to run, matching the Tired moodle.
4 = Exhausted (default, hardest to avoid only when truly spent).
3 = Very Tired.
2 = Tired (most punishing).
Sandbox_PassingOutTime_tooltip: Over how many in-game minutes the screen gradually blacks out before you actually fall asleep.
Sandbox_PassOutWarn_tooltip: Shows a one-time on-screen warning roughly 10 in-game minutes before you begin passing out.
Sandbox_PassOut_PanicKeepsAwake_tooltip:
While panicking you fight off sleep instead of collapsing. Each save also reduces your panic, so heavy panic only delays the inevitable.
Turn off for a stricter playthrough where nothing stops you from dropping.
Sandbox_PassOut_ForcedSleepSeconds_toolt:
Multiplayer and split-screen. After collapsing you stay knocked out for at least this many real seconds and cannot wake up early by moving - the original mod let you pop straight back up.
At 0 you can wake by moving after a 3-second grace, so a key you were still holding as you dropped does not cancel the collapse.
Sandbox_PassOut_SleepQuality_tooltip:
How restful collapsing is, using the game's own bed-quality recovery.
Floor: you sleep on bare ground and barely recover - realistic but punishing, and you may even wake still tired.
Rough / Average / Good let you recover more, as if you'd found somewhere better to rest.
Default is Floor: collapsing on bare ground barely rests you.
Sandbox_PassOut_CollapsePose_tooltip:
Your character sinks to the ground when they pass out instead of sleeping bolt upright, and gets back to their feet on waking.
In multiplayer everyone running the mod sees it, so it is obvious you have dropped rather than gone AFK.
Turn off to keep the vanilla standing-asleep look.
Sandbox_PassOut_WhileDriving_tooltip:
On: you can drop at the wheel - the car keeps rolling with no one steering and you slump onto the horn, drawing every zombie around. Exactly as dangerous as it sounds.
Off: collapsing is held off while you're the driver, so you stay awake until you stop or get out.
